captureDesign.entryGate: Break at the exact prepare_layer symbol entry, require callback PC and breakpoint location to equal its start, require exactly 40,128 bytes and the frozen full-symbol SHA-256, revalidate all five prior 4 KiB windows, and revalidate the exact 404-byte union_bounds symbol before installing the live marker.
captureDesign.sourceSelection: Independently select the first capture_backdrop+0x2b58 candidate with the exact x19/x20/x24 pointer chain, owner binary64 rectangle equal to the layer-state integer rectangle, and source integer rectangle still different.
captureDesign.markerRule: Install only prepare_layer+0x3ef0 before source selection. Retain at most 32 preselection records; after selection reject nonmatching x28 values and accept exactly the first live marker whose x28 is the selected source. Every retained record includes x19/x28 aliases, exact frame and backtrace, required registers, the complete 2 KiB role, and its 32-byte aggregate.
captureDesign.watchpointArmRule: Arm never retrospectively. At the first source-known live exact-source marker, read eight bytes at x19+656, require them to equal the same bytes in the marker's role snapshot, install one write-only hardware watchpoint, and immediately disable the marker.
captureDesign.watchpointQualificationRule: For every raw hardware stop, search the live bounded backtrace for the exact 40,128-byte prepare_layer symbol. Retain it as a qualified event only if that frame's unwound x19 equals the watched role base and its unwound x28 equals the independently selected source. A direct writer may be frame zero; a helper writer must retain its exact parent prepare_layer frame.
captureDesign.ignoredStopRule: Count all nonqualifying hardware stops separately up to the 8,192 raw-hit bound. Retain at most 64 distinct diagnostics grouped by stop PC, function, module path, and whether any exact prepare_layer frame was seen. Unrepresented groups receive an explicit count. Ignored stops never consume the 24-event qualified budget.
captureDesign.qualifiedEventRule: Retain at most 24 qualified events. Each records chained before/after bytes, change predicate, raw and qualified indices, top writer frame and backtrace, exact qualifying prepare_layer frame and unwound registers, a PC-containing 4 KiB code window, complete watched role, private fields, all scalar and SIMD registers, 2 KiB stack, selected object prefixes, register-pointer probes, and readable prepare-layer role probes.
captureDesign.semanticSeal: The CI validator may prove only exact code and object identity, live arm provenance, current-frame ancestry and register qualification, payload integrity, complete accounting, bounded coverage, at least one changed qualified event, and inherited timeline gates. It may not decode the writer or infer a universal crop rule.
captureDesign.nullOutcome: Any Apple code drift, non-entry callback, source-selection failure, marker truncation, retrospective or mismatched arm, no changed qualified event, invalid ancestry or unwound roles, raw/ignored/qualified accounting mismatch, incomplete operands, debugger failure, stopped target, or inherited validator failure fails closed while preserving the artifact.
